# passage-cli v0.4.0

This release stops the CLI from silently overwriting work that changed while a command was running.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owainlewis/passage-cli/main/install.sh | bash
```

## Changed

- `passage push`, `passage replace`, and `passage append` now write only if the document is still at the version they read.
- If somebody edited the document in the browser, or another agent wrote to it, the command stops, writes nothing, and exits unsuccessfully.
- The conflict message names the current version and tells you to read the document again, fold in your change, and write it back.
- A conflict is never retried as a forced overwrite.

## Notes

Requires a Passage server with document versioning. Against an older server these commands behave exactly as they did in v0.3.0.
